drafts.subject: Re: Speaking invitation - AgentConf 2026 (Oct 14-15, Berlin)
drafts.message:
Dear Elena,

Thank you so much for the invitation to speak at AgentConf 2026. We're excited about the opportunity!

We'd be happy to accept. One of our team members will give the 30-minute talk on Jac and the walker model. I'll follow up shortly with the confirmed speaker's name, bio, and headshot for the program.

Regarding logistics — it's great that travel and accommodation are covered. Could you share any additional details on hotel arrangements and the booking process? Also, is there a preferred date or time slot for our talk within the Oct 14–15 schedule?

Looking forward to a great conference!

Best regards,
Jaseci Team
